title: Courses without a teacher
statementMd:
Find courses that currently have no teacher assigned.

Expected columns: `title`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title FROM courses WHERE teacher_id IS NULL;
```
